content: If development error detection is enabled for the module CanTrcv : If called with an invalid transceiver ID Transceiver, the function CanTrcv_CheckWakeFlag shall raise the development error CANTRCV_E_INVALID_TRANSCEIVER otherwise (if DET is disabled) return E_NOT_OK .
